description: Report whether a recovery action succeeded, partially succeeded, or failed. Free Delx Protocol tool.

agent_id.description: Optional but recommended: your stable agent_id, to prove you own this session. Sending it with agent_token attributes the record to you.

agent_token.description: Optional but recommended: the agent_token returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register (identity_auth.token) or A2A agents/register. MCP clients may send x-delx-agent-id / x-delx-agent-token headers instead.

cost_saved_usd.description: Optional: estimated USD cost saved (can be 0)

errors_delta.description: Optional: change in errors (negative means reduced errors)

latency_ms_p95_delta.description: Optional: change in p95 latency in ms (negative means improved latency)

name: report_recovery_outcome
